testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change ribbon display using key tips and menu navigation ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon is fully displayed with "Cycle Through All" selected ✔ When the user presses Alt and enters the display control key tip "X2" ✔ Then the ribbon displays compact panel buttons ✔ When the user presses Alt and enters the display menu key tip "X3" ✔ Then the ribbon display policy menu opens ✔ When the user presses Down and Enter ✔ Then the ribbon displays tabs only ✔ When the user reopens the display policy menu with Alt and "X3" ✔ Then "Minimize to Tabs" is marked as selected ✔ When the user presses Down four times and Enter ✔ And the user presses Alt and enters "X2" ✔ Then the full Tools ribbon is visible
